messages:
maria: Heads up — I'm proposing we split the client->gateway shim into two runtime paths: 'merge-proxy' (backwards compat) and 'direct-sdk' (lightweight, bypass some proxy logic). Sketch below. Please weigh in.

kevin: :eyes: can you show the header contract? console attribution for quotas needs a stable signal. if direct-sdk drops the shim header we risk splitting metrics.

maria: totally. Plan is to always emit an authoritative X-RW-Route header with a stable route_id; merge-proxy keeps the older X-RW-Shim for compatibility. direct-sdk will sign headers with a light signature so server can validate origin.

maria: example request headers:

```http
GET /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-RW-Route: app:billing:gen-1
X-RW-Signed: s=sha256:abcdef...
```

aj: handshake concern — how do we avoid spoofing? we need a small negotiation step and a nonce exchange. also quota enforcement when clients send both headers.

maria: handshake sketch: first request hits /negotiate, server returns mode and nonce. client signs nonce for subsequent requests. pseudocode response:

```json
{"negotiate": "ok", "mode": "direct", "nonce": "abc123"}
```

kevin: on telemetry: ingestion should prefer X-RW-Route if present and map to console's route_hint. also ensure sampling doesn't double-count between proxy and direct paths.

sam: rollout suggestion — start direct-sdk in opt-in for 10% of traffic and only internal tenants for first canary. we'll add a console flag to monitor route-level metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy queued -> staging cluster @ 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z, job #2345 :rocket:

kevin: small UX ask: console request table should add a `mode` column (merge|direct) and expose handshake failures. that will make debugging easier for integrators.

maria: agreed. fallback behavior: if signed header is missing or invalid, server falls back to merge-proxy path and emits a telemetry tag `rw_mode=fallback`.

aj: edgecases: gRPC metadata casing, header size (some clients can't exceed ~512B), and HTTP/2 multiplexing. i'll add e2e tests for 512B header limits and metadata propagation.

kevin: also add metric `sdk.mode_switch_failures` with tags `{sdk:py|ts|go,reason}` and an SLO to alert on spikes.

maria: timeline: docs + SDK changes this week, staging canary next week, GA in ~3 weeks. blockers?

kevin: :thumbsup: devex ok, will draft release notes and migration guide.

sam: rollback plan: feature flag `disable_direct_sdk` toggled at routing plane; immediate flip disables direct acceptance and re-maps to merge-proxy.

maria: thanks — i'll open the RFC + PRs (sdk + runtime + console). ping me for reviews and i'll tag owners in PRs.
